name: MonarchEditableCell
title: EditableCell
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField (through MonarchTextField) for text and numbers, androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu for choices, androidx.compose.material3.DatePickerDialog with DatePicker for dates, switched in place from a clickable androidx.compose.material3.Text
summary: A table cell that edits its value in place: text, a number, a choice from a menu or a date from the Material 3 date picker, with checks, an asynchronous save and an error that keeps the editor open.
whenToUse: For changing one value of a row where it is shown: an amount, a stage, an owner's name or a close date in a list of deals or a record's detail rows.
whenNotToUse: For a title or a note outside a table use MonarchInlineEditText. For several values saved together use a form with MonarchTextField, MonarchSelect and a save button.
api: @Composable fun <T : Any> MonarchEditableCell(value: T?, label: String, editor: MonarchEditableCellEditor<T>, onCommit: suspend (T?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, startEditing: Boolean = false, saveOnFocusLoss: Boolean = true, format: ((T) -> String)? = null, validate: ((T?) -> String?)? = null, onCancel: (() -> Unit)? = null, onEditingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchEditableCellLabels = MonarchEditableCellLabels())

sealed class MonarchEditableCellEditor<T : Any> { data object Text : MonarchEditableCellEditor<String>; class Number(min: Double? = null, max: Double? = null) : MonarchEditableCellEditor<Double>; class Select<T : Any>(options: List<MonarchSelectOption<T>>) : MonarchEditableCellEditor<T>; class Date(min: Long? = null, max: Long? = null) : MonarchEditableCellEditor<Long> }

class MonarchEditableCellLabels(edit: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, save: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, saving: String? = null, invalidNumber: String? = null, required: String? = null, belowMin: ((min: String) -> String)? = null, aboveMax: ((max: String) -> String)? = null, noValue: String? = null, saveFailed: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The saved value, or null for an empty cell.

options.name: label
options.description: What the cell holds, for example "Status for Acme": the spoken name of the cell and the label of its field.

options.name: editor
options.description: Text, Number(min, max), Select(options) or Date(min, max); it also fixes the type of the value: String, Double, the option value, or epoch milliseconds in UTC.

options.name: onCommit
options.description: Saves the new value. Not called when the value did not change. Throw to keep the cell editing with the error; the exception's message is shown.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false the value is plain text in the disabled color and cannot be edited.

options.name: required
options.description: Refuses an empty value with "Enter a value." and leaves out the select cell's None item.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in view mode while the cell is empty, and as the field's placeholder.

options.name: startEditing
options.description: Opens the editor when the cell first appears, for a new row.

options.name: saveOnFocusLoss
options.description: Saves a text or number when focus leaves the field, like the web's save on blur.

options.name: format
options.description: Writes the value for view mode. By default the text, the number in the locale's format, the option's label or the medium date in UTC.

options.name: validate
options.description: Returns a message to refuse a value before it is saved, or null to allow it. Runs after the required and range checks.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Called when editing is cancelled with Cancel, back, Escape or by dismissing the menu or dialog.

options.name: onEditingChange
options.description: Called when the editor opens or closes.

states.name: viewing
states.description: The formatted value, or the placeholder in the subtle text color, as one button at least 48dp high. Numbers are aligned to the end with tabular figures.

states.name: editing text or number
states.description: A focused MonarchTextField with the cell's label and the current value as the draft, and Save and Cancel buttons under it.

states.name: choosing
states.description: A select cell shows a menu from the cell with None (unless required) and the options; the current one is selected and disabled options are dimmed.

states.name: picking a date
states.description: A date cell shows the Material 3 date picker in a dialog limited to min and max, with Save, Cancel and None (unless required).

states.name: saving
states.description: A progress indicator; the text field is disabled and Save shows its loading state. A menu or dialog has closed and the cell shows the progress at its end.

states.name: refused or failed
states.description: A text or number editor stays open with the message as the field's error. A select or date cell shows the message under the value in the danger color and keeps the saved value.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Plain text in the disabled color, without a button.

appearance: In view mode the value uses the default text role and the placeholder the subtle text role, with no border so the cell sits in a table row. The field, menu and dialog take their Monarch colors from MonarchTheme in light, dark and both high-contrast themes; errors use the danger strong role and also have text.
platformNotes: The web EditableCell opens with a click, Enter or F2, saves with Enter and on blur and cancels with Escape, using a text input, a native select or an ISO date input. On Android the select cell opens a Material 3 menu from the cell and the date cell opens the Material 3 date picker dialog, so dates are epoch milliseconds in UTC instead of YYYY-MM-DD strings and a typed invalid date cannot happen. Text and number cells keep the web's keys (Done saves, a hardware Escape cancels) and add visible Save and Cancel buttons and the system back gesture, because a phone keyboard has no Escape key. The web's controlled editing prop, initialDraft (type to edit) and trigger="none" for a DataGrid that owns focus are not offered: startEditing and onEditingChange cover a new row. The value type is fixed by the editor, so a number cell takes and returns a Double. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: In view mode the cell is one button whose name is the label and whose state description is the shown value or the placeholder; the double-tap action is read as "Edit" with the label.
The view button and Save are at least 48dp by 48dp.
The text editor is a Material 3 text field labelled with the cell's label; a refusal or failure is set as its error, so TalkBack reads it with the field.
Menu items carry the selected state for the current value, and disabled options are read as disabled.
The error under a select or date cell is in a polite live region, so it is announced when it appears.
The progress while saving has the spoken name "Saving".
edgeCases: A blank text or number draft is an empty value (null); a required cell refuses it.
Number drafts ignore spaces and read the locale's decimal comma when there is no dot, so "2,5" is 2.5 in German; group separators other than spaces are not read.
Range errors format the limit in the locale: "Enter 10,000 or less." in US English.
An unchanged value closes the editor without calling onCommit; for text the comparison is after trimming.
With saveOnFocusLoss, moving focus out of the field commits the draft, so a refused draft shows its message again each time focus leaves.
Date values are UTC midnights from the Material 3 picker; formatting them in the device zone instead of UTC can show the previous day west of UTC.

examples.title: Editing a text cell
examples.template:
MonarchEditableCell(
    value = title,
    label = {{label}},
    editor = MonarchEditableCellEditor.Text,
    onCommit = { next -> title = next },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    startEditing = true,
)
examples.setup: var title by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("Quarterly review") }
examples.code:
MonarchEditableCell(
    value = title,
    label = "Title",
    editor = MonarchEditableCellEditor.Text,
    onCommit = { next -> title = next },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    startEditing = true,
)

examples.title: A date cell with a range
examples.code:
MonarchEditableCell(
    value = closes,
    label = "Close date for Acme",
    editor = MonarchEditableCellEditor.Date(min = 1_767_225_600_000L),
    onCommit = { closes = it },
    placeholder = "No date",
)
